tips.text: Hunt the Duet inside the Antivirus Bounty on a Coda-controlled node so one run pays Hex standing, Antivirus mods and disinfection.
Run the Concert solo; every squadmate's Coda gets its own fight and a squad earns only one extra Heartcell per Coda.
Bring a frame that ignores the stage hazards: Revenant, Nyx, Titania, Valkyr, Dante, Inaros or Yareli.
Kill DJ RoM first in a Duet; his Toxin skips shields, so a shield tank is the trap.
Slot three different Antivirus mods at once, then swap the two dead ones for Potency mods once you know the right one.
Run Immuno Shield and Instant Secure (+15% each) with the correct Antivirus to reach 100% in three stabs.
Vanquish the Coda at the Concert, never Convert; a Convert pays zero Heartcells.
Abort right after a correct-Antivirus stab; the progress banks, but a Quick Correct Heartcell and the bounty reward are lost.
Slot Turbo Protect and Threat Blocker when stabbing; their drop chances keep your Antivirus and Potency mods stocked.
Use a fast frame (Titania, Volt, Gauss, Wukong) for the spawn and disinfection runs.
Back away from the stage for pyro, keep moving for rockets and the spotlight, and bullet-jump the lasers.
Rotate between Coda-controlled nodes; each node you complete leaves the Duet spawn pool until you land a correct stab.
Don't fail a Duet mission; it resets the escalating spawn chance.
Stay clear of the stage edge; players have got stuck under the arena geometry and lost the run.
Run the Antivirus Bounty on Steel Path for extra standing.
Buy your first copy at whatever roll Batch B shows, then keep 10 Heartcells banked and watch each Batch B for 52.8% or better.
Players call the Coda the least painful adversary system; about 28 Codas gets every Coda weapon to 60%.
The stadium Concert is the real friction, not the shop; people split on whether it is good boss design.
